verdict.rationale: Logseq has no native automation or scheduling feature in the evidence. Background automation is only possible indirectly, by building it yourself: an opt-in local HTTP API server gives external tools authorized access to the graph, the logseq:// protocol lets third-party apps invoke actions, and plugins extend functionality. The only automatic behaviour documented is the built-in midnight journal page creation, which is not user-configurable. Missing for 10: native user-defined automations or triggers, scheduled or background task execution, agent-driven autonomous workflows, and any evidence (docs or hands-on) of a plugin or integration actually running unattended automations.
